name: use-fold
title: Use Fold
description: Whether a part of a conversation is open: what the app's rule says for it as it is now (open while a tool runs, closed once it is done) until the reader opens or closes it; FoldProvider keeps the reader's choices by key, also when the part unmounts and mounts again. FoldFindable tells folds a conversation find is open (useFoldFindable); FoldFindText is a closed fold's text meanwhile, hidden until found, opening the fold when found.
